title: rosa canina f. sylvularum
intro: Rosa canina f. sylvularum, commonly known as dwarf or alpine rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa canina plant, a type of wild rose that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is rich in health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina f. sylvularum include soothing and calming effects, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation, as well as anti-diarrheal and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina f. sylvularum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
